notes: *no wickedness* divides under rule 15: the clause's negation is recast onto the object as a determiner, so לֹא takes *no* and אָוֶן keeps its own word.
אִשָּׁה and מְנָאָפֶת are split because the ASV spends a word on each; rule 30's generic-head-noun fusion reaches only a pair rendered by one English word.
